premises.text: Online fraud is large and growing faster than e-commerce, with costly human review and conversion-killing challenge questions that fail to identify customers
premises.evidence_span: $20 billion was lost to online fraud

premises.text: A real-time identity platform combines social fingerprinting with behavioral and transactional data to score customer authenticity for merchants
premises.evidence_span: We're a real-time online identity verification platform

premises.text: Checkout social sign-in verifies the profile via posts and real-world mappings and can pre-populate checkout forms
premises.evidence_span: we pre-populate the online checkout form with the customer's data

premises.text: Merchants integrate via JavaScript, Magento plugin, and REST API
premises.evidence_span: we have our JavaScript module, which can be combined with our Magento plugin and also our REST-based API

premises.text: Pricing is simple per-transaction pay-as-you-go without annual contracts or monthly minimums
premises.evidence_span: it's per transaction. You just pay for what you use

value.text: Merchants know who they are doing business with and reduce online fraud without destroying conversions
value.evidence_span: knowing who you're doing business with

causal_links.evidence_span: bring about an end to online fraud
We give the merchant a score, and that score is all about authenticity
It's really like Stripe for fraud

notes: Fraud losses, review burden, and challenge-question conversion destruction folded as one merchant problem set (§4.1.6). Social/behavioral/transactional scoring cascade folded into the identity platform premise; checkout verify+prepopulate kept as checkout UX path within product. Integration options folded as one developer surface. Seed/Telefonica/team excluded (§4.2). Vision that commerce is about knowing counterparties treated as value, not extra premise (§4.1.4). Anti-template: problem, verification product, and pricing separately revisable.
